newsitem.title: FINLAND: PK Cables Oy says share issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: PK Cables Oy says share issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Finnish industrial wiring maker PK Cables Oy said on Monday its share issue was oversubscribed and that shareholders were closing it.
"Institutional investors and retail investors made purchase commitments on 28 million PK Cables Oy shares which is over 10 times the amount offered in the share sale," PK Cables said in a statement.
Altogether 4,400 investors had made commitments to buy PK Cables shares, the company said.
The sellers will decide on the distribution of the shares on March 19, and will send confirmation to investors on around March 20, PK Cables said.
The listing of the shares is expected to begin on April 3, 1997, PK Cables said.
